facts.fact: 游岛次日早晨 Kayla 收短信邀请与表单，填写偏好与边界，之后通知八点接送
facts.anchor: My invitation came via text this morning—only a day after my tour—with a link to a form asking general things

facts.fact: 入岛后工作人员给 Kayla 一条蓝、黑、黄三色轮闪的腕带，其他参与者颜色没她多
facts.anchor: The melted-face man hands me a wristband. It lights up and flashes blue, then black, then yellow.

facts.fact: Nixie 对参加者说合同保护安全，腕带可定位且颜色对应猎手，并警告别进玉米地
facts.anchor: The contracts you signed will keep you safe. The wristbands are trackers, in case you get lost

facts.fact: 夜猎开始后 Kayla 主动去精神病院找 Vero，虽自称不怕，现场惊吓仍使她肾上腺素上升
facts.anchor: I know exactly where Vero will be, so I head toward the asylum.

facts.fact: Vero 借广播声称自己害怕脑中的寂静，并探出 Kayla 怕熊、某首歌也刺中她
facts.anchor: “Everyone fears something. Wanna know a secret? I’m scared of the silence in my head.”

facts.fact: 黑暗走廊里 Clay 抓住 Kayla 阻路并推撞墙，她还击后他离开；这不是 Vero 本人
facts.anchor: A hand closes around my arm, yanking me off my feet

facts.fact: Brawley 守在下一间，称 Kayla 若想接近 Vero 必须赢得资格，随后的接触与威胁不能写成明示同意
facts.anchor: “You want what’s mine,” he says, “but you’re going to have to earn it.”

facts.fact: Kayla 认出尾随她的黄腕带男子应是 Ares，被推进黑房间后 Vero 出现
facts.anchor: There is a man standing at the end of the hall in a glow mask, and for the first time, I notice he is wearing a wristband like mine, flashing yellow.

facts.fact: 最后 Vero 注意 Kayla 在发抖，她否认并主动亲吻了他
